What I see in the news is that everyone around me is adapting under pressure: Carlos doing EV cert, Priya being honest with her manager about the shrinking book, Jake trying to close units before the savings bleed gets worse, Tamika building a freelance client base. Even Angela is quietly building a consulting entity on the side. The common thread is: nobody is waiting for someone to save them. The grant program is real — 12 new enrollments this month. My application is in. I need to follow up and make sure it did not get lost. The $2,500 would buy me roughly one month of runway. That is not a solution but it is a bridge.
